title: Nutty Crispy Malaysian Cabbage Satay
description: A cozy and flavorful dish featuring Hispi sweetheart cabbage, perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Cut the Hispi sweetheart cabbage into thin strips, about 1/4 inch thick.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Add the grated ginger and garlic powder to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook, stirring frequently, until they are lightly toasted and fragrant.
Add the cabbage to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until it is tender and slightly caramelized.
Add the coconut milk mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the cabbage is coated.
Season the satay with black pepper to taste.
Transfer the satay to individual fondue pot portions and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Optional: serve with additional toasted peanuts and lime wedges on the side.
